responsibility: Owns the HIR scope-tree data structures used to model lexical regions and cleanup scopes, including parent relationships, variable lifetimes, temporary/rvalue extension candidates, and yield locations, and provides queries for scope containment and variable scope lookup needed by borrow checking and related analyses.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `ty/region.rs`, which defines the interned type-system notion of regions/lifetimes (`Region`, `RegionKind`, bound/placeholder/early/late forms), this file models lexical HIR scope trees and cleanup scopes used for borrow-checking-style scope containment and variable lifetime lookup.
